definition.matching: same standardized callsign, same intent family, absolute time difference within 60s, order-preserving one-to-one alignment
definition.parameter_match: supplementary numeric target agreement using family/unit tolerances; not required for the primary action match
definition.primary: macro average across reference aircraft of matched historical commands / historical reference commands

warnings: A score is meaningful only when system outputs are produced independently in historical shadow replay.
Do not call the model only at historical command times; that would leak reference timing.
Report full-scope and conflict-resolution-only subsets separately when the system supports only conflict resolution.
